note: Test files whose GPU memory high-water or capacity checks hold only in a fresh pytest process: with XLA_PYTHON_CLIENT_PREALLOCATE=false the XLA pool grows across the files one process runs and never shrinks, so these fail after other GPU files and pass alone (relax#131; the unit suite with natives on one A100, Slurm 16212966 and 16220845). scripts/run_test_tier.py runs each listed file in its own process in the medium sweep (smoke runs every touched GPU file in its own process).
